## Game facts 游戏要点

- 3 reels × 3 rows, single middle payline; three matching symbols pay 8×–200× the bet; any pair returns the stake
- 3转轮×3行，单条中线赔付；三连按8×–200×下注奖励；任意对子返还本金
- Symbol weights per reel: cherry 26%, lemon 22%, grape 18%, bell 14%, star 10%, seven 6%, diamond 4%
- 转轮符号权重：樱桃26%、柠檬22%、葡萄18%、铃铛14%、星星10%、幸运7 6%、钻石4%
- Balance, bet and statistics persist in the player's own browser via localStorage; free 1,000-chip refill
- 余额、下注与统计仅保存在玩家自己的浏览器（localStorage）；筹码可免费补充
- Entertainment and education only, intended for adults 18+; virtual chips have no monetary value and no real-money gambling exists on this site
- 仅供娱乐与学习，限18岁以上；虚拟筹码无任何货币价值，本站绝无真钱赌博
